changeSet.author: hephaestus

preConditions.onFailMessage: the reasoning effort of both model catalogs and the binding column are required to move the effort to the binding

changeSet.sql: UPDATE workspace_agent_binding binding SET reasoning_effort = CASE WHEN binding.purpose = 'MENTOR' AND model.effort IN ('MEDIUM', 'HIGH', 'XHIGH', 'MAX') THEN 'LOW' ELSE model.effort END FROM ( SELECT b.id, coalesce(instance_model.reasoning_effort, own_model.reasoning_effort) AS effort FROM workspace_agent_binding b LEFT JOIN llm_model instance_model ON instance_model.id = b.instance_model_id LEFT JOIN workspace_llm_model own_model ON own_model.id = b.workspace_model_id ) model WHERE model.id = binding.id AND binding.purpose IN ('PRACTICE_REVIEW', 'PRACTICE_DECISION', 'MENTOR') AND model.effort IS NOT NULL

changeSet.author: hephaestus

preConditions.onFailMessage: workspace_agent_binding.timeout_seconds is required to raise the Heph turn ceiling

changeSet.sql: UPDATE workspace_agent_binding SET timeout_seconds = 900, updated_at = now() WHERE purpose = 'MENTOR' AND timeout_seconds >= 300 AND timeout_seconds <> 900

rollback.sql: UPDATE llm_model model SET reasoning_effort = review.effort FROM ( SELECT instance_model_id AS id, min(reasoning_effort) AS effort FROM workspace_agent_binding WHERE purpose = 'PRACTICE_REVIEW' AND instance_model_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY instance_model_id HAVING count(reasoning_effort) = count(*) AND count(DISTINCT reasoning_effort) = 1 ) review WHERE model.id = review.id

UPDATE workspace_llm_model model SET reasoning_effort = review.effort FROM ( SELECT workspace_model_id AS id, min(reasoning_effort) AS effort FROM workspace_agent_binding WHERE purpose = 'PRACTICE_REVIEW' AND workspace_model_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY workspace_model_id HAVING count(reasoning_effort) = count(*) AND count(DISTINCT reasoning_effort) = 1 ) review WHERE model.id = review.id
